$description: ThoughtLeap brand design tokens. Extracted 2026-06-10 from the ThoughtLeap Canva Brand Kit (kAGmuIbuJ6s) and verified by pixel-sampling exported brand designs (DAGp4K1U0Is social posts, DAG2oUDNBT8 marketing). Hex values are exact, not approximations.

navy.$description: Primary brand color. Exact wordmark color (TL_horizontalmark_navy.svg). Carries full-bleed grounds in brand layouts.

navy-deep.$description: Logomark arrow fill (Arrow_Icons-01.svg). Functionally same family as navy; use navy unless matching the logomark exactly.

vermilion.$description: Signature accent. Logomark dot, eyebrow labels, full-bleed accent grounds. 3.3:1 on cream - large text and graphics only, never body copy.

cream.$description: Brand surface. Card and panel background across all sampled designs (58-87% coverage on card pages).

ink.$description: Headline and body ink on cream surfaces. Verified true black in exports, not navy.

white.$description: Text and wordmark on navy or vermilion grounds.

steel-blue.$description: Secondary ground (full-bleed alternate to navy). Navy text on it passes 4.62:1.

sky.$description: Tagline and accent text on navy grounds. 4.41:1 on navy - large/bold text only.

mist.$description: Core identity light blue, not just a tint: logo badge background, the light-blue logo colorway, supporting text on navy (7.89:1, body-safe), and an occasional full-bleed ground (launch post p7 at 74.5%).

silver.$description: Light gray panel color on cream/white layouts (24-25% coverage where used). Verified in social posts p2 and launch posts p2.

frost.$description: Cool near-white panel gray on white layouts (15% coverage where used). Verified in social/launch posts p4.

tan.$description: Warm secondary block color (photo frames, alternating panels).

peach.$description: Small decorative tint (dots, soft shapes). Decoration only.

ember.$description: Darkened vermilion used as the hard offset shadow behind cream cards on vermilion grounds.

eyebrow.$description: Short uppercase labels on cream, e.g. IT'S TIME. Large/bold only (3.3:1).

display.$description: Open Sans, confirmed by Brandon 2026-06-10. Headlines bold, set in ALL CAPS on social cards, sentence case for taglines, tight leading.
display.case: uppercase for short headlines, sentence case for taglines

body.$description: Open Sans, confirmed by Brandon 2026-06-10. Regular weight, sentence case, generous line height (~1.5).

logo.$description: Complete variant inventory from account-wide Canva sweep 2026-06-10 (folders, design search, fills inspection of 12 designs). Local PNGs are low-res pulls; master SVGs live in Canva. Colors below are pixel-sampled from the actual asset files.

wordmark-horizontal-navy.$description: Horizontal 'ThoughtLeap.ai', navy. The footer sign-off on cream social cards. A BLACK-rendered instance (#000000, pixel-verified) appears on some cream cards - that is a Canva recolor of this file, no separate black SVG exists.

wordmark-horizontal-white.$description: White counterpart of the navy horizontal wordmark, for navy/vermilion grounds (Facebook covers, banners).

lockup-horizontal-lightblue.$description: Mist/ice-blue horizontal lockup WITH the rounded-square badge inline (navy arrow + vermilion dot). Note: Canva filename says 'vertical' but the asset is horizontal. Used on navy LinkedIn banners.

lockup-stacked-navy.$description: PRIMARY HERO LOCKUP: two-line 'Thought / Leap.ai' in navy with mist rounded-square badge (navy arrow + vermilion dot). Shown full-bleed on cream in the brand's own social set.

lockup-stacked-white.$description: White stacked lockup with mist badge, for navy grounds ('For the Humans' post).

logomark-navy.$description: Paper-plane arrow (navy) + offset dot (vermilion). Standalone mark; also used oversized as background watermark.

logomark-lightblue.$description: Ice-blue arrow + vermilion dot, for navy grounds. Hero graphic on LinkedIn banners; the avatar mark on the navy LinkedIn profile pic. Fill #D1DBEB is a hair lighter than mist #CEDBED (different file, same family).

logomark-navy-alt.$description: Later re-upload (Feb 2026, in Uploads) of the navy/vermilion arrow - same colorway as Arrow_Icons-01, slightly different geometry/crop. Prefer Arrow_Icons-01 unless matching newer collateral.

gaps.$description: Arrow_Icons-02.svg was never found in any folder or design (the -01/-03 numbering implies it exists in the Brand Kit, which the API cannot enumerate). No separate black wordmark file exists - black instances are recolors of the navy SVG.

card-radius.$description: Approximate large rounded-corner radius on 1080px social cards. Scale proportionally (~3.7% of canvas width).

card-shadow.$value: offset hard shadow, no blur, darker shade of the ground hue (e.g. ember #C74825 on vermilion)
card-shadow.$description: Signature offset-panel motif: cream card sits ~15px offset above a same-shape darker copy.
